page.layout: One page of text: a Greek verb paradigm table. Left column of labels (Perfectu., Infinitu, Praesens) with Greek forms in two further columns; headings centred between the rows. Printed page 88, running head "SECVNDA PARS" at the top. Catchword "Infini" at lower right.
page.notes: Greek forms are reproduced from a worn printed scan; the accents and a few letters of the second column are doubtful and may differ from the printer's exact forms. The line "Infinitum b." is read from a letter resembling a figure 6, and may be a misreading of b. The final "Infini" at lower right is set as a catchword.
